verdict.rationale: Natural-language operation is a fair question for an online government service portal, but nothing in the evidence shows the IRS offers a natural-language command interface. Its documented channels are web forms gated by ID.me sign-in, registration-gated XML/SOAP machine channels (MeF, IRIS A2A), and paper or fax rails. None of these accepts natural-language commands, and the probes found no llms.txt or OpenAPI surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
